goals.goal: A paused or blocked run is charged wall time for the wait and is exhausted on resume. Time a run spends paused (from orbit pause to orbit resume) or BLOCKED waiting for a person must not count against scheduler.hard_limits.wall_minutes; a run that is never paused or blocked is charged as before.

Re-submitting a goal that is already running creates a duplicate run without a warning. orbit run must refuse a goal that an unfinished run of the same repository already has, naming that run and how to continue it.
The secret scan prints trufflehog's raw finding, so a found secret lands in the transcript. The git hook must still name what was found and where, without printing the secret itself.
